simple.meaning: עוּגָב (ʻûwgâb) is a Hebrew word meaning “a reed-instrument of music.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עוּגָב (H5748) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 4:21, with occurrences in Genesis, Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עוּגָב (H5748) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עוּגָב (H5748) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עוּגָב (ʻûwgâb) / H5748 is traced through Genesis 4:21, Job 21:12, Job 30:31, Psalms 150:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H5748. uggab עוּגָב noun masculine a musical instrument (possibly from above √, because of sensuous or appealing tones); — Gen 4:21 (J; + כִּנּוֺר ), Job 21:12 (|| כִּנּוֺר תֹּף, ), Psa 150:4 ( + מִנִּים ), suffix עֻגָבִי Job 30:31 (|| כִּנֹּרִי ); — according to ᵑ7 a reed-pipe or flute ( אַבוּבָא ), ᵑ9 a Pan's pipe ( organon , made up of several reeds together); Now Archaeology i. 277 Benz Archaeology 276 think of bag-pipe ( = סוּמְמֹּנְיָה Dan 3:5 , 10 , 15 ), compare also in We Psalms Eng. Tr. 219 ; > a stringed instrument ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ( Gen 4:21 ). עֻגָה see עוג . עגל (√ of following; compare Late Hebrew עָגַל Niph`al berounded ; Pi`el roll a thing, etc.; Aramaic Pa`el roll a thing, and derivatives; עֲגוּלָא ᵑ7 rolled cake, עֲגִילָא shield , בַּעֲגָלָא , Syriac in swiftnees, swiftly ; Arabic hasten, be swift , compare Lag BN 31, 143 ).
definitions.rootNote: or עֻגָּב ; from 5689 in the original sense of breathing;

occurrences.englishText: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
They sing to the tambourine and harp,
Therefore my harp has turned to mourning,
Praise him with tambourine and dancing!
